style: Premium minimal SaaS sonic-logo sting (Linear / Notion / Vercel register). Near-black stage, one breathing light motif, metallic wordmark, a single specular pass, nothing decorative that can't name its job. Reusable 4s intro for Physiofit product-launch and Academy videos.

palette.note: accent pair is a placeholder health-mint; swap to the official Physiofit brand colours via the composition variables

font: Geist SemiBold (OFL, embedded via @font-face from assets/fonts)

asset_needs.status: placeholder — official Physiofit logo could not be resolved (physiofit.app blocked by this environment's egress policy; media-use logo resolve found no provider match). Stand-in monogram tile + typeset wordmark; drop the official SVG into the mark slot to replace.

reused.text-shimmer: specular gradient band technique (one clean sweep, then clean text) — adapted to a masked clone of the wordmark
reused.grain-overlay: fractal-noise grain at very low opacity, finite iteration count, to kill gradient banding in the encode

hand_authored: inhale/exhale light motif (hairline expands, contracts into a point, mark blooms out)
wordmark slides out from under the tile on the mark's expo.inOut curve (clip edge tracks the tile)
custom synthesized sonic logo, composed frame-accurately to the beats

cues.what: inhale — reverse-reverb swell of the hit chord + rising air
hit — sub drop + felt transient + Dmaj9 bloom pad + glass bell
air whoosh following the mark slide (pans left)
soft harp-like gliss, one note per letter as it slides out from under the tile (measured: sound/letter-emergence.json)
shimmer sparkle following the specular sweep L→R
exhale — downward air, tail decays to silence at 4.0

brief: Out of black, a single point of light breathes in: a hairline stretches across the centre, then contracts back into the point (inhale, the sound swells as a reversed echo of the chord to come). On the downbeat at 0.8s the Physiofit mark blooms out of that point — blur to sharp, one soft ring, a warm sub and a Dmaj9 chord with a glass bell. The mark glides left with an expo in-out while the metallic wordmark slides out from under it (a quiet harp gliss, one note per letter as it appears). The lockup settles with a soft chime, a single specular light pass travels across mark and wordmark, then everything exhales — blur, fade, a downward breath — into black at 3.7s, leaving a clean reverb tail to 4.0s. Dominant motif: breath — inhale, bloom, exhale — which is both premium-minimal and literally physiotherapy.
